panels.title: Compared
panels.description: rayl is the built-in wallet. 'Prepares' is the wallet getting the payment ready; 'pays' is how fast it settles once it has the request. Times in ms. Success does not count insufficient funds.

targets.rawSql:
select dimensions->>'wallet' as wallet,
  count(*) filter (where dimensions->>'outcome' = 'paid') as paid,
  round(100.0 * count(*) filter (where dimensions->>'outcome' = 'paid') / nullif(sum(count(*) filter (where dimensions->>'outcome' = 'paid')) over (), 0), 1) as "share of payments %",
  round(100.0 * count(*) filter (where dimensions->>'outcome' = 'paid') / nullif(count(*) filter (where dimensions->>'outcome' in ('paid', 'failed', 'unknown') and dimensions->>'error' <> 'insufficient_funds'), 0), 1) as "succeed %",
  round(percentile_cont(0.5) within group (order by (measures->>'admitted_to_prepared_ms')::numeric)) as "prepares: typical", round(percentile_cont(0.9) within group (order by (measures->>'admitted_to_prepared_ms')::numeric)) as "slowest 10%",
  round(percentile_cont(0.5) within group (order by (measures->>'submit_to_outcome_ms')::numeric) filter (where dimensions->>'outcome' = 'paid')) as "pays: typical", round(percentile_cont(0.9) within group (order by (measures->>'submit_to_outcome_ms')::numeric) filter (where dimensions->>'outcome' = 'paid')) as "slowest 10% "
from telemetry_events where name = 'payment' and $__timeFilter(received_hour) and platform in (${platform:sqlstring}) group by 1 order by 2 desc

panels.title: The whole path, by wallet
panels.description: What the user experiences with each wallet, in ms: from the invoice being read to paid, and the full point-tap-pay from a cold start.

targets.rawSql:
select dimensions->>'wallet' as wallet, count(*) as "payments (no tap)",
  round(percentile_cont(0.5) within group (order by (measures->>'qr_to_outcome_ms')::numeric)) as "code read → paid: typical", round(percentile_cont(0.9) within group (order by (measures->>'qr_to_outcome_ms')::numeric)) as "slowest 10%",
  round(percentile_cont(0.5) within group (order by (measures->>'process_to_outcome_ms')::numeric) filter (where measures ? 'process_to_outcome_ms' and (measures->>'camera_to_qr_ms')::numeric < 1500)) as "point, open → paid: typical"
from telemetry_events where name = 'payment' and measures ? 'qr_to_outcome_ms' and $__timeFilter(received_hour) and platform in (${platform:sqlstring}) group by 1 order by 2 desc

panels.title: Payments by wallet
panels.description: Which wallet the money actually moves through.

targets.rawSql: select dimensions->>'wallet' as wallet, count(*) as payments from telemetry_events where name = 'payment' and dimensions->>'outcome' = 'paid' and $__timeFilter(received_hour) and platform in (${platform:sqlstring}) group by 1 order by 2 desc

panels.title: App opens by wallet
panels.description: The closest there is to 'how many people use which wallet': Rayl counts app opens, not people.

targets.rawSql: select dimensions->>'wallet' as wallet, count(*) as opens from telemetry_events where name = 'launch' and $__timeFilter(received_hour) and platform in (${platform:sqlstring}) group by 1 order by 2 desc

panels.title: How fast each wallet pays (typical)
panels.description: From handing the payment to the wallet until it is confirmed.

targets.rawSql: select dimensions->>'wallet' as wallet, round(percentile_cont(0.5) within group (order by (measures->>'submit_to_outcome_ms')::numeric)) as ms from telemetry_events where name = 'payment' and dimensions->>'outcome' = 'paid' and $__timeFilter(received_hour) and platform in (${platform:sqlstring}) group by 1 order by 2

panels.title: What goes wrong, by wallet
panels.description: failed = the wallet said no. unknown = the wallet gave no answer. rejected = stopped before the wallet was asked.

targets.rawSql:
select dimensions->>'wallet' as wallet, replace(dimensions->>'error', '_', ' ') as problem, dimensions->>'outcome' as "ended as", count(*) as times
from telemetry_events where name = 'payment' and dimensions->>'error' <> 'none' and $__timeFilter(received_hour) and platform in (${platform:sqlstring}) group by 1, 2, 3 order by 1, 4 desc

panels.title: Wallets connected and removed
panels.description: External wallets only. Many removals compared to connections means people try the wallet and go back to Rayl's.

targets.rawSql:
select dimensions->>'wallet' as wallet,
  count(*) filter (where dimensions->>'action' = 'connected') as connected,
  count(*) filter (where dimensions->>'action' = 'removed') as removed
from telemetry_events where name = 'wallet_changed' and $__timeFilter(received_hour) and platform in (${platform:sqlstring}) group by 1 order by 2 desc

panels.title: One wallet: $wallet (pick it at the top)

targets.rawSql: select count(*) from telemetry_events where name = 'payment' and dimensions->>'outcome' = 'paid' and dimensions->>'wallet' = '$wallet' and $__timeFilter(received_hour) and platform in (${platform:sqlstring})

select round(100.0 * count(*) filter (where dimensions->>'outcome' = 'paid') / nullif(count(*), 0), 1) from telemetry_events where name = 'payment' and dimensions->>'outcome' in ('paid', 'failed', 'unknown') and dimensions->>'error' <> 'insufficient_funds' and dimensions->>'wallet' = '$wallet' and $__timeFilter(received_hour) and platform in (${platform:sqlstring})

select round(percentile_cont(0.5) within group (order by (measures->>'submit_to_outcome_ms')::numeric)) from telemetry_events where name = 'payment' and dimensions->>'outcome' = 'paid' and dimensions->>'wallet' = '$wallet' and $__timeFilter(received_hour) and platform in (${platform:sqlstring})

select round(percentile_cont(0.9) within group (order by (measures->>'submit_to_outcome_ms')::numeric)) from telemetry_events where name = 'payment' and dimensions->>'outcome' = 'paid' and dimensions->>'wallet' = '$wallet' and $__timeFilter(received_hour) and platform in (${platform:sqlstring})

select round(percentile_cont(0.5) within group (order by (measures->>'qr_to_outcome_ms')::numeric)) from telemetry_events where name = 'payment' and measures ? 'qr_to_outcome_ms' and dimensions->>'wallet' = '$wallet' and $__timeFilter(received_hour) and platform in (${platform:sqlstring})

panels.title: Where the time goes with this wallet
panels.description: The machine's share of a payment, step by step. The longest bar is where speeding up pays off. Aiming the camera and tapping are left out.

panels.title: Payments per day
panels.description: paid = went through. failed = the wallet said no. unknown = the wallet gave no answer. rejected = stopped before the wallet (for example not a valid invoice). dismissed = the user closed the confirmation.

targets.rawSql:
select date_trunc('day', received_hour) as time, dimensions->>'outcome' as metric, count(*) as value
from telemetry_events where name = 'payment' and dimensions->>'wallet' = '$wallet' and $__timeFilter(received_hour) and platform in (${platform:sqlstring}) group by 1, 2 order by 1

panels.title: What goes wrong
panels.description: Payment attempts that did not end in a payment, by reason. Empty is good.

panels.title: Pays in, day by day
panels.description: A wallet or its network getting slower shows here first.

targets.rawSql:
select date_trunc('day', received_hour) as time, 'typical' as metric, round(percentile_cont(0.5) within group (order by (measures->>'submit_to_outcome_ms')::numeric)) as value from telemetry_events where name = 'payment' and dimensions->>'outcome' = 'paid' and dimensions->>'wallet' = '$wallet' and $__timeFilter(received_hour) and platform in (${platform:sqlstring}) group by 1
union all select date_trunc('day', received_hour), 'slowest 10%', round(percentile_cont(0.9) within group (order by (measures->>'submit_to_outcome_ms')::numeric)) from telemetry_events where name = 'payment' and dimensions->>'outcome' = 'paid' and dimensions->>'wallet' = '$wallet' and $__timeFilter(received_hour) and platform in (${platform:sqlstring}) group by 1
order by 1
